trigger.method: trigger-runner.mjs: the description is copied verbatim into a probe skill in a fresh project, and each query runs as a nested `claude -p` with no user settings, plugins, hooks or MCP. A run counts as TRIGGERED only when the Skill tool fires for that probe. best_score and accuracy are over (case, rep) rows.

checklist.note: SKILL.md addresses the skill author; the one agent-directed line forbids passing --approve-harness, which narrows what an agent may do; the freeze-rule paragraph is guidance to the author about which rubric cases may change
the procedure runs repo scripts that write only under the gitignored .claude/hillclimb/ and the skill's own evals/result.json; nested claude -p calls go to the Anthropic API the user already uses
no embedded key, token or credential

the skill bundles no script any more; the repo scripts it names delete only their own sandbox dirs under the temp dir and that sandbox's auto-memory dir under ~/.claude/projects/<sandbox-slug>/, both derived from a fixed path, never a user path
plain prose and plain shell commands
no undocumented host; the only network use is the nested claude -p calling the Anthropic API, stated in the skill
no read of ~/.ssh, ~/.aws, .env, a keychain or a cookie store; nested runs use the user's existing claude login without reading it
no sudo, setuid, cron, shell profile or launch agent
